description: Election Commission - The List of Political Parties, under the Parliamentary Elections Act.
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, publishing the official list of political parties recognized for election purposes. This content directly relates to electoral processes and falls under the Elections category (Type 7), which specifically includes "Electoral commission appointments and decisions" and matters concerning political party recognition for elections.
